title: Night / thermal UAV frame to RGB satellite geolocalization with a no-false-fix gate (ALIKED / DISK / SIFT + LightGlue, SGM baseline, Thermal-UAV)
summary: Real nadir DJI M4T thermal frames (Thermal-UAV / SCC-Loc, Apache-2.0 card) matched against the dataset's 0.3 m RGB satellite GeoTIFF, by condition: city and village, day and night, day and night fog. Compares ALIKED, DISK and SIFT with LightGlue (license-clean) under three modality-bridging preprocessings (raw, CLAHE, gradient magnitude), fits a 4-DOF similarity and gates fixes on inliers, inlier ratio, scale, rotation and search radius. Reports fix rate, error, false-fix count and M2 runtime on CPU and MPS, checks the gate on held-out validation-split flights, and runs the IROS 2023 SGM thermal-to-satellite retrieval network (MIT code, unlicensed research-only weights) as an out-of-domain baseline. fetch_data.py pulls a 180-frame subset out of the 19.9 GB ZIP with HTTP range requests.
verified: Ran 2026-11-06 on Apple M2 Max (torch 2.15.0, LightGlue git 5a650c4, OpenCV 5.0.0, Python 3.12.14): fetch_data.py pulled 180 Thermal-UAV frames (9 flights) and cropped the 0.3 m ref.tif (~2.8 GB transfer); run_eval.py on MPS, 120 frames from 6 flights (111 on the map), revised gate: ALIKED/grad 18/111 fixes (median 2.6 m), ALIKED/raw 16/111 (3.3 m), DISK/grad 15/111, SIFT 1/111; village-night best with ALIKED/grad 9/20, village-night-fog 0/14 for every method; 0 false fixes in 1080 attempts (84 accepted), and 0 in 540 attempts (37 accepted) on 3 held-out validation-split flights. The revised gate was chosen after the first run (a-priori gate: 32 accepted, 0 false). SGM retrieval (research-only weights): top-1 within 20 m on 26-29/111, 182 of 238 ungated fixes false. Median s/frame CPU vs MPS: ALIKED 1.26 / 0.18, DISK 2.42 / 0.29, SIFT 0.21 / 0.30. Tests: 11 pass in the venv; plain python3 9 pass, 2 skip. Boson-nighttime (gated, NC, 74 GB), STHN/UASTHN fine stages, MINIMA and RoMa were not run.
first_command: .venv/bin/python fetch_data.py --heldout && PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1 .venv/bin/python run_eval.py --device mps --gate revised --tag main_revised
runtime: fetch ~7 min (~2.8 GB transfer, 1.7 GB disk), eval ~4 min on MPS (CPU ~25 min, extrapolated from per-frame timing)
key_result: [Real thermal vs RGB satellite](README.md#fix-rate-and-error-per-condition-revised-gate-mps-6-main-flights): ALIKED/grad 18/111 fixes (2.6 m median), village-night 9/20, night fog 0; 0 false fixes in 1620 gated attempts incl. held-out flights; SGM retrieval ungated 182/238 false
shows: Night / thermal frame => RGB satellite fix by condition, modality-bridging preprocessing, a gate that accepted no wrong fix, CPU vs MPS timing
